Game Overview

Orbit.io puts players into a io experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Orbit.io comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Orbit.io?

Orbit.io is a free io game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Orbit.io free to play?

Yes, Orbit.io is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
